messages:
releasebot: Starting staged rollout v2.14.0 -> 12% traffic (region: us-west). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Deploy ID: dpl-439876.

mike: heads up — this rollout includes reranker model change (rnk-v3). watching embedding/relevance metrics.

sarah: thanks. can we get preflight perf? p95 baseline and rerank CTR

deploybot: Canary metrics (12%):
- p95 latency +42ms (baseline 280ms -> 322ms)
- 5xx rate 0.12% (baseline 0.03%)
- rerank CTR down 9% on purchase_flow

anna: rerank CTR down 9% is big for purchase_flow. do we have sample L7 logs? @raj can you grep for err signatures?

raj: grabbing logs now. small sample shows score normalization shift — candidates deprioritised.

ops-alert-bot: Alert: spike in client-side score-skew logs from proxy-3 (us-west-2), 03:12 UTC

mike: propose HOLD at 12% and pin to previous stable v2.13.8 while we investigate. Agree? :thinking_face: 

sarah: +1. prefer pin and rollback on low risk path.

anna: agree. open a rollback path. we should also snapshot current traffic for repro sets.

releasebot: Action items:
1) HOLD rollout at 12%
2) PIN staged config to v2.13.8
3) Create repro set: purchase_flow-repro-439876

mike: commands:
```
# pin rollout
/release pin dpl-439876 --version v2.13.8
# rollback if needed
/deploy rollback dpl-439876 --to v2.13.8
```

raj: executing pin now.

raj: done — pinned. Deploybot confirms: rollout traffic frozen at 12% and pinned to v2.13.8 :white_check_mark:

sarah: opening postmortem channel and flagging QA to run full reranker evals against purchase_flow.

mike: thanks. ops, keep an eye on p95 and CTR. We'll reconvene in 20m for go/no-go.

ops-alert-bot: Noted. Monitoring dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/rollout/dpl-439876

anna: +1. any further anomalies call immediate rollback. :rotating_light:

mike: meeting 03:40 UTC quick sync. tagging oncall @kevin for visibility.

kevin: oncall here, watching metrics, stand by.

releasebot: thread closed for immediate actions — update when ready to proceed.
